name: distributional-critics-2026-10-24
hypothesis: The fixed saved-SAC soft-consistency diagnostic motivates testing whether truncated distributional critics improve selected and final trading returns. This does not assume that value offsets cause bad action gradients.
smoke_parameters: Existing native SAC smoke replay/warmup/batch32-network settings; preserveTQC2critics/25quantiles/drop0or2. No smoke-return-based tuning.

historical_control_reproduction.failure: Disable interpretation/promotion and report mismatch. Never widen tolerances or retry automatically.

selection_metric: Unchanged equal-weight mean26-symbol development net return; report selected and actual final post-update weights independently

screen_gate.failure: Close fixed critic study; no quantile/truncation/temperature/reward/feature/step grid, extension or confirmation.

constraints.data: Original26-symbol retrospective training panel matches diagnostic and controls; this method study does not add stocks/indicators or activate financial inputs. Broader data remains a separate accepted experiment.
constraints.algorithm: SAC versus untruncatedTQC changes critic loss/output/aggregation; onlyTQCdrop0 versusdrop2 isolates fixed truncation with identical architecture.
constraints.source: Immutable training-only normalization, no fitting on development, no retired2024-September2026 prices opened.
constraints.short_side: Reconcile long/short costs and net P&L; require both positive total and positive short net P&L to describe profitable shorts. Future decline labels reporting-only,never selection/input.
constraints.smoke_acceptance: Actual Colab default Python/kernel inspected before dependency sync; checkers,quantile geometry,actual shared tensors/RNG,optimizer restoration,frozen prediction parity,artifact identity and projected deadline before screen.
constraints.failed_families: Prior SAC state/discount/temperature/regularization and price-feature failures remain closed. Fresh nativeSAC is a matched method control, not a rescue attempt.

execution.concurrency: Configurable existing centralized fleet; aggregate shared-ledger metering every minute and projected operations across all owned sessions
execution.cleanup: Durably checkpoint and retrieve with bounded retries;verify all owned session termination and publication checksums before duplicate cleanup;never stop unrelated sessions
